selection: 30 available preview push-ups, then all 67 remaining hash-ranked mirror-train candidates with published counts 2..30 and media <=25MB; 35 Countix-labelled videos in the official push-up validation archive. All screened before detector inference.
working_conditions: One clear exercising subject, ordinary floor push-ups (small fixed handles allowed), front/side or modest oblique view; visible arms and hip, knee/ankle in side view; no exercise-time cuts/composites, steep overhead views, severe crops, or compound/assisted variants. Small foot/head crops, backgrounds and clothing vary.
grouping: Source/publisher-family grouping where suspected overlap; athlete identities and hidden duplicates are unverified. No athlete-independent qualification claim.
review: Five fixed original-image samples per source; continuity between samples is not proven. Screening never reads model outputs. Intro/outro cuts permitted; no uncut-session claim.
scoring: Published repetition-count agreement in each dataset labelled interval. Per-cycle boundary alignment is diagnostic only; published phases are not adjudicated to our completed-return convention. Missing/failed runs stay in the denominator.

screening.reason: ordinary push-up, visible required body, stable exercise view at source review samples
